steps.name: Bernardo
steps.text: The most unremarkable Dipartimento di Sicurezza Alimentare...

steps.name: Bernardo
steps.text: And its popular but underappreciated segretario.

steps.name: Rubio
steps.text: At this point, men like Carracci, who were propped up to maintain balance between the major famiglie, are no longer needed.

steps.name: Rubio
steps.text: What you need is a puppet that is safe and useful.

steps.name: Rubio
steps.text: Am I wrong?

steps.name: Bernardo
steps.text: Signor Segretario, a truly safe and useful puppet would never refer to himself as such.

steps.name: Rubio
steps.text: I just happen to be a bit more self-aware than others.

steps.name: Bernardo
steps.text: Haha. And mightily self-aware you are.

steps.name: Bernardo
steps.text: You're right, Rubio. You are the best candidate to replace Carracci.

spans.text: the best candidate to replace Carracci.

steps.name: Bernardo
steps.text: But, if you're willing to be so frank with me, I might as well share something with you.

steps.name: Rubio
steps.text: I'm listening.

steps.name: Bernardo
steps.text: My associates killed Carracci.

steps.name: Bernardo
steps.text: You've got guts, and I like talking with men like you.

steps.name: Bernardo
steps.text: So I'm willing to give you a chance.

steps.name: Bernardo
steps.text: Turn around and leave this room, forget what you just said, and no harm will come to you.

steps.name: Bernardo
steps.text: Then, go back home and spend some time with your wife and daughter. Savor the last moments of peace in this city.

steps.name: Rubio
steps.text: Doesn't that mean you'd need a puppet like me all the more?

steps.name: Bernardo
steps.text: Hm?

steps.name: Rubio
steps.text: You're after this chaos. What's happening all around us.

steps.name: Rubio
steps.text: You want to overturn the law laid down by Signora Sicilia. But you don't care if she rules, or if we go back to the old ways.

steps.name: Rubio
steps.text: The conflict among famiglie never had anything to do with us commoners.

steps.name: Rubio
steps.text: When something happens, we just wait to see the result.

steps.name: Rubio
steps.text: It makes no difference to the commoners whether Signora Sicilia rules, or you do.

steps.name: Rubio
steps.text: But, the winner will need someone to maintain the facade of order.

steps.name: Rubio
steps.text: As the don of a famiglia, surely you understand this principle—

steps.name: Rubio
steps.text: It isn't impossible for the commoners to survive without the famiglie, but the same cannot be said for the famiglie without the commoners.

steps.name: Bernardo
steps.text: You're telling me that you hold the real power?

steps.name: Rubio
steps.text: No. I'm making a self-serving justification for the weak.

steps.name: Bernardo
steps.text: A good justification at that.

steps.name: Bernardo
steps.text: But it doesn't tell me what you're really after.

steps.name: Rubio
steps.text: Power, Don Bernardo.

steps.name: Rubio
steps.text: Since I was a kid, everyone's looked down on me, because I'm weak. And I look like, you know, this.

steps.name: Rubio
steps.text: The oppression I felt from the people around me was more real than anything the famiglie ever did.

steps.name: Rubio
steps.text: I've suffered that my entire life, waiting for this chance.

steps.name: Rubio
steps.text: You tell me you're one who had Carracci killed? All I can think is: thank goodness I came at the right time.

steps.name: Rubio
steps.text: You may not want to hear this, but if you're going up against Signora Sicilia, it's probably not going to go your way.

steps.name: Rubio
steps.text: But who cares? Doesn't matter to me if you win or lose, in the end—

steps.name: Rubio
steps.text: But power is something Signora Sicilia can't give me. It's gotta be you.

steps.name: Bernardo
steps.text: You're an honest man, Rubio. I like making friends with honest men.

steps.name: Bernardo
steps.text: Hm?

steps.name: Bellone Mafioso
steps.text: Don Bernardo... (*whispers*)

steps.name: Bernardo
steps.text: Give my order. Tell them, that's enough for today.

steps.name: Bellone Mafioso
steps.text: Of course.

steps.name: Sora
steps.text: What just happened?!

steps.name: Croissant
steps.text: That room over there... started shaking?

steps.name: Lappland
steps.text: Looks like she chose you.

steps.name: Sora
steps.text: Huh?

steps.name: Lappland
steps.text: That earthquake is Giovanna's Arts.

steps.name: Lappland
steps.text: Sounds like they had a falling out.

steps.name: Exusiai
steps.text: Look, Texas jumped out the window. Let's go after her!

steps.name: Sora
steps.text: Right!

steps.name: Lappland
steps.text: Ahh, Texas. If, and I mean if, we were friends back then... could I have kept you in Siracusa?

steps.name: Lappland
steps.text: Hah, fat chance, right?

steps.name: Lappland
steps.text: We would've just slaughtered each other.

steps.name: Carwash Worker
steps.text: Lavinia, don't make me... kill you.

steps.name: Carwash Worker
steps.text: I've got a job to do.

steps.name: Carwash Worker
steps.text: Signorina Lavinia, I pray that you aren't born in Siracusa the next time around.

steps.name: Rubio
steps.text: Just a second.

steps.name: Carwash Worker
steps.text: Who are you?

steps.name: Rubio
steps.text: You're one of Saluzzo's hitmen, right? This operation... is over.

steps.name: Rubio
steps.text: Don Bernardo's orders, just in.

steps.name: Bernardo
steps.text: Lavinia, you shouldn't have shown your face here.

steps.name: Lavinia
steps.text: That's not up to you.

steps.name: Bernardo
steps.text: You've interfered with a Saluzzo operation. That's going to ruin the relationship between our two famiglie.

steps.name: Lavinia
steps.text: Haha...

steps.name: Lavinia
steps.text: So, why don't you go beg Alberto's forgiveness with my head on a silver platter?

steps.name: Rubio
steps.text: Wait, please. Signor Bernardo... I mean, Don...

steps.name: Rubio
steps.text: I have a presumptuous request.

steps.name: Bernardo
steps.text: Hm?

steps.name: Rubio
steps.text: I imagine Signor Leontuzzo will be very busy in the future. It'll unrealistic to expect him to help me the way he did Carracci.

steps.name: Rubio
steps.text: I'd like to ask you for a new assistant.

steps.name: Rubio
steps.text: The judge here would be a suitable pick.

steps.name: Bernardo
steps.text: That certainly is one option.

steps.name: Lavinia
steps.text: What are you two talking about?

steps.name: Rubio
steps.text: Ah, how impertinent of me, carrying on this conversation without including the subject, Signorina Lavinia.

steps.name: Rubio
steps.text: Don Bernardo has decided that I, Rubio, the humble ex-Segretario di Sicurezza Alimentare, shall take Carracci's place as the next Ministro dei Lavori Pubblici.

steps.name: Rubio
steps.text: And I have to admit, I'm not too experienced with bureaucratic affairs.

steps.name: Rubio
steps.text: So I hope that you, as someone with ample experience, will become my assistant.

steps.name: Texas
steps.text: (I wonder how Sora and the others are doing...)

steps.name: Texas
steps.text: What? Why... are you here?
When you get old, you start looking for a place to enjoy the rest of your days.

steps.name: Rossati Mafioso
steps.text: Found her! She's right over there!

steps.name: Rossati Mafioso
steps.text: Surround her!

steps.name: Texas
steps.text: Looks like you insist on getting in my way.
She's still worried about you, after what happened.
As for me, I'm old now, so I spend my days taking care of the youth. It's a hobby.
Stay a while and have a chat with your elder.

steps.name: Texas
steps.text: Next time.

steps.name: Texas
steps.text: Croissant?!

steps.name: Exusiai
steps.text: Ohoh, let's have a look-see, who's off fighting all by herself?

steps.name: Texas
steps.text: Why are you all here?

steps.name: Exusiai
steps.text: As far as I can tell, the Siracusan families always fight together. It's your culture.

steps.name: Exusiai
steps.text: And Penguin Logistics's culture iiiis—

steps.name: Sora
steps.text: To party hard?

steps.name: Texas
steps.text: In this case, it should be—

steps.name: Texas
steps.text: Don't be afraid to rumble, right?

steps.name: Exusiai
steps.text: You got it!

steps.name: Exusiai
steps.text: Seriously though, old man. You think you could let this one slide, a favor from one Sankta to another?

steps.name: Croissant
steps.text: Get'cher head on straight, Exusiai.
You do have a point.
Ahh, the rainy season in Siracusa is a long one. It didn't bother me when I was young, but now, the arthritis is such a hassle.
Children, striving for strength is fine, but remember to put your health and safety first.

steps.name: Croissant
steps.text: Eh, yer pullin' my leg.

steps.name: Exusiai
steps.text: Thanks a bunch!

steps.name: Exusiai
steps.text: By the way, if I ever did want to talk with you, how could I find you?
If you're searching for redemption, I'm afraid there's nothing I can do for you.
But if you're searching for order, you will find me everywhere.

steps.name: Texas
steps.text: That's enough. Let's get out of here.

steps.name: Exusiai
steps.text: Woohoo!

steps.name: Wallach
steps.text: Donna.

steps.name: Giovanna
steps.text: What's the situation?

steps.name: Wallach
steps.text: The Bellones have retreated.

steps.name: Giovanna
steps.text: Good work.

steps.name: Wallach
steps.text: Where's Cellinia?

steps.name: Giovanna
steps.text: Gone.

steps.name: Wallach
steps.text: Gone?

steps.name: Giovanna
steps.text: She couldn't kill me, and I couldn't kill her.

steps.name: Giovanna
steps.text: Let's head back and prepare. The Bellones aren't going to let this go.

steps.name: Wallach
steps.text: Right.

steps.name: Wallach
steps.text: You've won, Leontuzzo.

steps.name: Demetri
steps.text: Your original plan wasn't to win over Wallach, was it?

steps.name: Leontuzzo
steps.text: But wasn't that the best option, given the circumstances?

steps.name: Demetri
steps.text: Can't deny that. *cough* *cough*

steps.name: Leontuzzo
steps.text: Alright, enough talk. Let's get you in the car.

steps.name: Demetri
steps.text: Leon, you still haven't given up, have you?

steps.name: Leontuzzo
steps.text: Compared to what Lavinia has been through, this setback is nothing.

steps.name: Demetri
steps.text: You're going to do great things.

steps.name: Demetri
steps.text: Maybe one day, you might actually be able to realize your dreams in Siracusa.

steps.name: Leontuzzo
steps.text: And when that time comes, you'll be my right-hand man.

steps.name: Demetri
steps.text: I don't get along with Lavinia.

steps.name: Leontuzzo
steps.text: There are some things better left to her, and others better left for you.

steps.name: Demetri
steps.text: Haha, you cheeky bastard. You're already thinking about that kind of stuff?

steps.name: Leontuzzo
steps.text: Demetri... I'm still angry about what you and my father were plotting.

steps.name: Leontuzzo
steps.text: I don't understand why he insists on continuing, even now.

steps.name: Leontuzzo
steps.text: But, in the end, I'm still a part of this famiglia.

steps.name: Exusiai
steps.text: Safe landing!

steps.name: Sora
steps.text: *gasp*... *gasp*... It feels great to be back on our own turf.

steps.name: Exusiai
steps.text: Phew... Siracusans sure are a pain in the ass. I'm totally wiped.

steps.name: Exusiai
steps.text: You hanging in there, Sora?

steps.name: Sora
steps.text: Yes. But my dress got a little torn up.

steps.name: Exusiai
steps.text: Well, shoot. That one was awfully expensive, wasn't it?

steps.name: Sora
steps.text: Ahaha, we'll figure something out.

steps.name: Exusiai
steps.text: Alrighty, one bottle per person.

steps.name: Sora
steps.text: C'mon, knock it off with that stone face.

steps.name: Sora
steps.text: Just think of it this way: the three of us also happened to be on vacation here.

steps.name: Texas
steps.text: Then... what's with the show?

steps.name: Sora
steps.text: Oh... That's, umm... just a way to grow my career~

steps.name: Sora
steps.text: Plus, I thought it might make finding you a little easier.

steps.name: Croissant
steps.text: I reckon it sure did, lookin' at the way things turned out.

steps.name: Texas
steps.text: Sure enough.
The atmosphere remains chilly for a while.
But finally, an unavoidable problem emerges.
Where do they go from here?
Texas does not have it in her to ask.

steps.name: Croissant
steps.text: Tex...

steps.name: Sora
steps.text: Texas, I had an agreement with the director.

steps.name: Texas
steps.text: Hm?

steps.name: Sora
steps.text: Now that I've found you, I will stay here and complete my performance contract.

steps.name: Texas
steps.text: But—

steps.name: Sora
steps.text: I've spoken with the director a few times. It's a little scary, in retrospect, but I don't think he's the kind of man to hold our lives over you.

steps.name: Exusiai
steps.text: You have a point. If he wanted to do something like that, he would've locked us up a long time ago.

steps.name: Croissant
steps.text: Okay, alright, let's quit the jawin'. You keep talkin' and I keep gettin' scareder n' scareder.

steps.name: Sora
steps.text: We really are here to see you. If it wasn't so dangerous out there, I'd like you to show us around.

steps.name: Texas
steps.text: Okay... When we're through all this, I'll give you a tour.

steps.name: Exusiai
steps.text: Anyways, let's celebrate this Penguin Logistics reunion in Siracusa!

steps.name: All Four
steps.text: Cheers!

steps.name: Croissant
steps.text: The biggest thing—

steps.name: Sora
steps.text: Hm?

steps.name: Sora
steps.text: An unknown number...

steps.name: Sora
steps.text: I don't remember ever giving out this number...

steps.name: Sora
steps.text: Hello? Who am I speaking with...?

steps.name: Bernardo
steps.text: It seems you're safe and sound, Signorina Sora. That's a relief.

steps.name: Sora
steps.text: You know what happened with Texas, right?

steps.name: Bernardo
steps.text: Don't worry, Signorina.

steps.name: Bernardo
steps.text: Your Penguin Logistics friends must be enjoying a joyous reunion.

steps.name: Bernardo
steps.text: And I certainly don't want to interrupt that.

steps.name: Bernardo
steps.text: But I was just thinking you might have a lot of questions for me.

steps.name: Bernardo
steps.text: So, I'll be waiting for you at the theater tomorrow.

steps.name: Sora
steps.text: Right.
